title: Master panel
chainOk: The chain is intact: {count} documents, every fingerprint and seal matches.
chainBroken: The chain breaks at link no. {at} ({kind}).
featuresHelp: A disabled feature is offered nowhere, whatever the plan.

integration.title: Integrations
integration.intro: Keys are stored encrypted and never shown back — you only see the last 4 characters. An empty field keeps the saved value. Values set here take precedence over the server .env.

checkErrors.unauthorized: Revolut rejected the key (401/403). Make sure it is the Secret key for the selected environment.
checkErrors.missingKey: No Secret API key is saved.
checkErrors.network: The server could not be reached.
checkErrors.smtp: The SMTP server refused the connection.

errors.invalidPort: The port is a number from 1 to 65535.
errors.invalidFrom: The sender is “Name <address>” or just an address.
errors.invalidSecret: The key is at least 8 characters, no spaces.
errors.invalidWebhookSecret: The webhook secret starts with wsk_.

integration.checkSmtp: Check and send a test email to {email}

transfer.title: Transfer to the owner
transfer.intro: This company was added by an accounting firm and has no owner. Check a proof of representation (current Commercial Register extract or a power of attorney), then send an invitation to the representative's email. They take over the profile with one link; the firm's mandate stays.
transfer.checked: I have checked the proof of representation.
transfer.sent: The invitation to {email} for {company} is valid until {date}.
transfer.mailQueued: The email is queued and leaves within a minute.
transfer.mailNotReady: Email is not configured yet — the message is waiting. You can also send the link yourself.
transfer.linkOnce: Shown only now — the database keeps only its fingerprint. A new invitation revokes this one.

errors.notChecked: Tick that you have checked the proof of representation.
errors.hasOwner: The company already has an owner.
errors.invalid: The invitation is no longer open.
